page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated virtual CPUs and 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware.

The underlying CPU architecture lacks support for advanced instruction sets such as Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and hardware-accelerated cryptography (AES, SHA_NI). Additionally, hyper-threading and virtualization extensions are not exposed to the guest operating system. These hardware limitations restrict the instance from executing highly parallel vector calculations or hardware-accelerated cryptographic operations efficiently.

Operating with a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance represents a standard general-purpose configuration. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without the performance degradation associated with shared-core or burstable models. It is structured for lightweight workloads that do not require specialized hardware accelerators, such as basic web serving, small-scale application hosting, and development environments.
